summary: Verified new GitHub App installation-health check + App-only reconnect CTA. All 4 backend pytest cases pass and all 3 UI flows (Settings card suspended install, in-chat banner suspended, in-chat banner deleted) render exactly per spec. Regression check confirmed: /github/app/installations still filters active=true only, so wizards/repo-pickers are unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: GitHubCard 'GitHub login' subtext currently reads 'Connected as @null' when the OAuth `login` field is null but `connected` is true — cosmetic pre-existing bug, not part of this changeset.

RevokedRepoBanner: When reason='installation_deleted', banner strong-text still reads 'GitHub App access paused' (via APP_LEVEL_REASONS set). Deleted is semantically closer to 'removed/uninstalled' than 'paused'. Consider a distinct label for the deleted case (nit; functional behaviour is correct).

repo_status.installation_id field is added inline to short-circuit no_check rows but is NOT set on the healthy `_check_one` path — banner will only see installation_id when the project is disconnected via installation_suspended/deleted. That is exactly what the frontend needs, so this is fine; noting for future readers.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 github_installations rows (iid 999999042=suspended, 999999043=deleted) + 2 matching cto_projects rows (test_suspended_proj_042, test_deleted_proj_043). All 4 rows deleted after tests — final verify count=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All installation-health / reconnect-CTA branches verified. Suspended → direct link to https://github.com/settings/installations/{id}. Deleted → still uses ORIGINAL popup-based reconnect button. Settings card correctly filters out deleted installs. Regression: /github/app/installations still active-only. Fixtures cleaned up.
